input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (ventures brief)

doc_friction.issue: Sent this session to einvoice-preflight (row 3); every open item in its next: needs a real file or a blocked host (boe.es, sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, financnasprava.sk, slov-lex.sk, gov.il all returned no connection from this container). The row has no inputs_only/buildable marker, so later runs will repeat the probe.
Second choice (photo-editing, the explicit BUILDABLE row) was claimed by #15854 one minute after allocate ran; the table cannot see same-minute claims, as its own text warns.

deviations.why: Assigned row (einvoice-preflight) had nothing buildable from this container; did not add inputs_only because only some hosts were probed and the CIUS-PT validator question might still be readable.
deviations.did: Took open-tennis-robots, whose buildable list named the power-distribution model, and landed it.
deviations.result: Landed the model, a firmware fault fix (spin-up ramp) and tests.

goal: Deepen a flagship with a hard engineering slice
notes: Feeder.power_distribution/check_power: branch fuses and gauges, 30 A main fuse and contactor, 23.3 A worst draw vs 24 A (80% of an assumed 30 A BMS). Found: speed loop feedforward stepped ESC throttle at once (unramped ~49 A per ESC). Added controller.SpinupRamp (1500 rpm/s then 100 W shaft power); tests/spinup_ramp_sweep.py on the simulated feeder: unramped median per-wheel peak 871 W, 6000 rpm/s cap 436 W, 1500 rpm/s worst 110 W; steady from rest 4.9 s worst (was 2.4 s). Manufacturing package rebuilt (BOM/manifest/README only, 0 design rules, 0 collisions). Verification: run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots ok (124.8 s); pytest tests 89 pass; cad PowerParamsTest+PowerBomTest pass; full cad suite 92 passed (249 s, includes the committed-package-is-current check); venture-preflight clean (first run failed only on this record's then-empty outcome).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an electrical engineer sizing branch fuses, contactor and BMS budget for a mixed-load robot, plus a firmware soft-start and its simulation sweep

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
